scope: Single process, text-only, deliberately shared fixture author; bulk loading excludes admission/verification throughput; deleting rows does not compact SQLite allocation; no connection churn, power loss or media load

reproduce: nix develop .#interface --command bash -c 'RUSTFLAGS="-C link-arg=-fuse-ld=mold -C target-cpu=native" cargo test -j 2 -p engine --lib disk_backed_directory_and_local_cache_search_baseline -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads 1'

workload.fixture_loading: Every document correctly signed; bulk load bypasses public admission/per-owner capacity. Authority/revision/index rows retained. Periodic validation plus first-page signature/hash validation.
workload.local_storage: Retain 10,000 listings after deleting 90,000; no VACUUM, so main-file and WAL allocation are not a fresh 10,000-entry footprint.
workload.samples: Ten warmups then fifty measured full Engine requests in each phase; bounded correct non-overlapping continuation
